thread:
Maria CSM: Heads-up — StellarHealth QBR next Tue 10am PT. Pulling together account health + token econ for the deck. Quick snapshot below, please flag anything off and add enablement notes.

Raj FinOps: Thanks — preliminary spend forecast and anomaly notes. See snippet.
```
Monthly tokens (est): 2,150,000
Avg $/1k tokens: $2.38
Projected monthly $: $5,117
Variance vs last month: +42% (embed-heavy flows)
Alert: sudden spike on 3/14 correlating with onboarding emails
```

Anna CS: Onboarding is ~85% completed for their new data pipeline. Remaining: API key rotation + one integration test. Customer asked for a short walkthrough on prompts. Renewal signal: neutral -> lean positive if latency improves.

Ethan Support: Seeing a bump in embedding errors (rate limit 429) around the same time. Logs show retries piling up. I can throttle client-side or request increased burst from infra.

Lisa Enable: I can run a 30-min enablement refresh before the QBR focused on prompt engineering + cost controls. Available Mon 2pm PT. Would be good to capture 2-3 example prompts to optimize.

Raj FinOps: Two quick asks: (1) Are they on reserved capacity or hosted? (2) Any high-cost routes (e.g., long-context generation) we should call out in the QBR? If hosted, we can suggest batching + caching playbook.

Maria CSM: They're on hosted with a few dedicated endpoints for sensitive data. High-cost route is the nightly analytics job that re-embeds ~500k docs.

Ethan Support: I can gate the nightly job to run in smaller batches and add exponential backoff to avoid 429s. Will push a patch to their staging config tonight.

Anna CS: For latency, propose we trial a 4-bit quantized model variant for the analytics job — should cut cost ~30% and improve throughput. I'll own the A/B.

Raj FinOps: If quantization looks good, I can model the cost delta for the QBR slide. Need sample run numbers (tokens/time) — Anna, can you capture?

Anna CS: Yep — will run a 24h sample and post numbers by EOD tomorrow.

Lisa Enable: I'll prepare the enablement slides and two concrete prompt examples (one optimized for cost, one for accuracy).

OpsBot: Billing alert forwarded: "StellarHealth hosted usage exceeded projected threshold by 38% on 2025-03-14" — ticket #BILL-9342.

Maria CSM: Action items captured: 1) Anna run quant A/B sample (owner: Anna) 2) Ethan throttle/nightly batching patch (owner: Ethan) 3) Raj model cost delta for QBR (owner: Raj) 4) Lisa enablement session + slides (owner: Lisa) 5) Maria to consolidate QBR deck + send invite. Please add ETA next message.

Raj FinOps: ETA for cost modeling: tomorrow 4pm PT.

Anna CS: ETA for sample numbers: tomorrow 6pm PT.

Ethan Support: Patch deployed to staging tonight. ETA prod roll next morning 8am PT pending green tests.

Lisa Enable: Slides + enablement invite sent (tentative Mon 2pm PT).

Maria CSM: Great — I'll assemble the deck after Raj/Anna post numbers. If anything changes ping me here. Thanks :thumbsup:
